description: Return layout hints for a single disp id by combining disp-catalog metadata with aggregated typography (median size/x/y/w/h, frequent colors, alignment mode) mined from bundled marketplace templates. Use before authoring a new ItemList row or ItemPatchList.patch fragment — values are soft guidance, not firmware-enforced. Always clamp boxes to the logical canvas (typically 800×1280).

canvasHeight.description: Logical canvas height for clamp reminders (default 1280).

canvasWidth.description: Logical canvas width for clamp reminders (default 800).

name: watchface_layout_suggest
